# Internals

Internals should stay boring: build request, choose endpoint, call transport, classify errors, record metrics. Complex algorithms are added behind tests.

```text
Consumer
  |
  v
RpcClient
  |
  v
Generic JSON-RPC infrastructure
```

## Example

```ts
import { RpcClient } from '@beblurt/blurt-rpc-core'

const rpc = new RpcClient('https://rpc.example.org')
// Future implementation: await rpc.call('namespace.method', { id: 1 })
```

## Non-goals

No blockchain, scoring, signatures, health checks or MCP server code belongs here.
